# RefineParking

R package wrapping a modular Shiny app to explore BGC-Argo particle data (UVP6, optical sediment trap). Separate business-logic functions (data extraction, particle-size spectral slope, carbon flux derivation).


RefineParking::run_app(path_to_GDAC_CORE_data = "/home/flo/refine_argo/", path_to_GDAC_AUX_data = "/home/flo/refine_argo/")
